items.title: Worst experience from last 2mnths
items.text: I am extremely disappointed and frustrated with the way my WhatsApp account has been banned without any proper reason or explanation. I have been using this WhatsApp number for the past 8 years, and suddenly my account was banned even though I have not knowingly done anything wrong or violated any rules. What is even more frustrating is that I have not been given any clear reason for why my account was banned. I have sent numerous emails and requests to WhatsApp Support asking them to review my account and explain the issue, but I have still not received any proper solution or meaningful response.This is really unfair because this number is very important to me and I have been using WhatsApp on it for several years. Suddenly banning my account without providing a specific reason and then refusing to properly review or restore it is extremely disappointing.If I have made any mistake unknowingly, I am willing to understand and follow all WhatsApp policies in the future, but I genuinely believe that I have not done anything wrong that deserves a permanent ban. I respectfully request WhatsApp to properly review my case again, clearly explain the reason for the ban, and please restore my account. I have been patiently requesting help through multiple emails, but I am still not receiving a fair resolution. Please take my complaint seriously and give me a proper response instead of leaving my account banned without any clear explanation.

items.title: Request to remove my what’s app ban asap
items.text: I have been using WhatsApp with the same phone number for several years without any issues. However, over the past few weeks, my account has repeatedly been banned and placed under review without any clear explanation. Whenever I submitted a review request, my account was restored, but unfortunately, the same issue occurred again shortly afterward. My account has now been permanently banned, and it has been 18 days since the ban. There is currently no option available for me to request another review. I have also tried contacting WhatsApp Support several times, but I have not received a proper response or a solution to this issue. This situation is extremely concerning because my WhatsApp account contains important personal conversations, contacts, photos, documents, and other valuable information that I have accumulated over many years. I kindly request that you manually review my account and investigate the reason for these repeated bans. If my account was restricted due to a misunderstanding or an error, I sincerely request that you restore my account and help ensure that this issue does not happen again.  I assure you that I will strictly comply with WhatsApp’s Terms of Service and all applicable policies going forward. Please consider my request and help me regain access to my account. I would greatly appreciate your assistance in resolving this matter as soon as possible.

items.title: Appeal to Unban WhatsApp
items.text: Dear WhatsApp Support Team, I am writing to respectfully request a review of my WhatsApp account, which has recently been banned. I believe this ban may have occurred due to a misunderstanding, technical issue, or an unintentional violation of WhatsApp's policies. WhatsApp is very important to me for communicating with my family, friends, colleagues, and other contacts. I use my account for genuine personal and professional communication and have never intentionally used WhatsApp for spam, fraud, harmful activities, or any other activity that violates the Terms of Service. If any activity from my account was detected as suspicious, I sincerely apologize for any unintentional mistake. I kindly request your team to conduct a manual review of my account and verify my recent activity. If my account was banned incorrectly, I would be very grateful if you could restore access to my phone number. I fully respect WhatsApp's Terms of Service and community guidelines and assure you that I will strictly follow all applicable rules in the future. Please reconsider my account ban and give me an opportunity to continue using WhatsApp. I am willing to complete any verification process required to confirm that I am the legitimate owner of the account. Thank you for your time and consideration.
